name: blueprint/file-vault
description: R2 as the agent's file system with the store as the index: rh_files_* moves blobs, rh_store holds metadata (tags, titles, fetchedAt), rh_files_share hands out time-boxed presigned URLs. The first blueprint on a real Cloudflare primitive.
use_cases: share a file for N minutes
index what is in the bucket
ingredients: rh_files_put / rh_files_get / rh_files_list / rh_files_share / rh_files_delete (Cloudflare R2, SigV4-signed)
rh_store index: one record per object { key, contentType, size, tags, fetchedAt }
createR2Client / signRequest / presignGet (exported, injectable for tests)
credentials R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID / R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY + settings accountId / defaultR2Bucket
recipe: rh_files_put the blob -> rh_store_put the index record -> find by scanning the index, not the bucket -> rh_files_share for a time-boxed URL when somebody else needs it -> rh_files_delete removes the blob AND its index record
result_kind: R2 objects + one store index record per object

invoke_contract.put: { key, content, contentType? } -> object stored + index record
invoke_contract.share: { key, minutes? } -> presigned URL valid that long (default 60, max 7 days)
invoke_contract.find: prefix scan of the index -> { key, tags, size, fetchedAt }[]

cost_hint: R2 storage on the user's own account (free tier exists); egress metered
pitfalls: a presigned URL is a secret for its validity window - treat it like one
content is text by default (text/plain) - set contentType for anything else
the signer is pinned to the AWS test vector - a SigV4 change that breaks it fails the test
absent keys answer { found: false }, not an error - that is the exists() check
keep metadata in the store index, not in object keys - rename-by-key rewrite is expensive
delete both places (blob + index) or the index lies
local_limits: needs the user's R2 credentials and accountId configured; built and unit-tested but not yet live-probed against a real bucket
cloud_limits: the first family on an actual Cloudflare primitive; Workers integration is the next escalation
